    DICE SNAKE

    Matching dice score their sum × how many matched. Three 3s = 9 × 3 = 27; two 6s = 12 × 2 = 24.

    HOW TO PLAY

    Matching dice score their sum × how many matched. Three 3s = 9 × 3 = 27; four 4s = 16 × 4 = 64; a straight scores the sum of all its dice × 3.
